name: MENTIGA

notable: HIS TIZA 以 RM21 million 收购 Mentiga 30% 股权。

recent_en: Mentiga saw recent shareholding changes: HIS TIZA acquired a 30% stake for RM21 million, and several substantial shareholders (including KDPM Tengku Hassanal, Tan Sri Norza, HIS Holdings, TIZA Global, HIS TIZA Pahang) filed changes in interest between Nov 10 and 19. The company also released monthly and quarterly production disclosures.
